title: T7 Evidence Synthesis & T9 Calibration-Readiness Closure
purpose: Reconcile the completed T7 native survival evidence chain and establish the final T9 evidence boundary without performing new modeling or inventing formal calibration quantities.

OP-004.acceptance_basis: T7 present in accepted_tasks; overall OP-004 status is not used as the T7 acceptance criterion.

semantic_boundary.OP-004_T7_acceptance_basis: T7 present in accepted_tasks; overall OP-004 status is not used as the T7 acceptance criterion.

uncertainty_evidence.interpretation: Native survival uncertainty was established for fixed-horizon IPCW Brier quantities. Formal survival calibration uncertainty remains not established.

T7.target: Time from Creation until first post-Creation operationally observed Status -> RESOLVED
T7.native_prediction_quantity: Survival distribution / predicted median survival time / survival probability at fixed horizons

final_t7_conclusion.interpretation: T7 has sufficient native survival evaluation and uncertainty evidence for T9 evidence closure. Native survival performance and uncertainty can be reported while preserving right censoring. A formal survival calibration estimator and formal calibration uncertainty remain unestablished and are therefore not claimed.

methodological_restrictions: Right censoring remains part of the target observation structure.
No survival quantity was converted into a binary classification target.
No model was selected in OP-013F.
No universal confidence score was created.
No universal risk score was created.
The T7 evidence boundary is closed for native survival evaluation, native uncertainty, and descriptive reliability.
closure_statement: T7 native survival evidence is closed for T9. Native survival evaluation, model comparison, IPCW Brier evidence, C-index evidence, and native uncertainty have been reconciled. Formal survival calibration and formal calibration uncertainty remain unestablished and must not be represented as completed calibration evidence.
